Can Beast take over an action originated by an action card e.g.
computer hacking through Mask of a thousand faces?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <8s09er$1b4$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

theve...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Can Beast take over an action originated by an action card e.g.
> computer hacking through Mask of a thousand faces?

No.

Any minion playing a Mask of a Thousand Faces must have been
able to play all of the other cards and modifiers up to that
point.

Basil (1 pt pander, obf) cannot take over any action that was
started with Presence / Dominate / a Title.

Similarly for Beast, since he cannot play action cards, he
cannot take over an action that started with an action card.

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra
